## Publication checklist

- [ ] The change is documentation-only; it contains no POC implementation or customer-delivery artefact.
- [ ] I used only original material or brief, explicitly approved open-source excerpts/assets.
- [ ] I found no client, engagement, employer, partner, confidential, personal, or credential data.
- [ ] Every external source has an immutable version, licence, and notice entry in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] Public availability was not treated as permission to copy, train, or redistribute.
- [ ] Synthetic examples contain no real identifiers or reconstructed confidential patterns.
- [ ] Visuals are original or have documented source and reuse rights.
- [ ] I disclosed AI-assisted content and reviewed its inputs and output provenance.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_public_content.py` passes locally.
- [ ] No dataset, model weight, adapter, checkpoint, embedding index, training run, or production configuration is included.
- [ ] The change does not imply official endorsement by NVIDIA or a customer.
- [ ] I am contributing through a pull request and do not require direct repository write access.
- [ ] I did not add a privileged workflow trigger, secret reference, mutable action tag, or external active content.
- [ ] The applicable review path is identified: Codex-managed owner review or external CODEOWNER review.
